description: `[1 2][1] = 5` (issue #407/F7): assigns to a postfix read over a list-literal base, not a place, raising the runtime's own `ol-not-a-place` (reached through `execute()`'s own check before Phase 2, mirroring `not-a-place-runtime-list-literal.expected.json`'s bare-list case) — proving `not-a-place-text.ts`'s runtime-side `PostfixExpressionNode` renderer, added in lockstep with the checker's, produces the same full target text `[1 2][1]`. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
